data.one_liner: Lint and DCM rules for Dart and Flutter used internally at Theodo Apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of custom lint and Dart Code Metrics (DCM) rules for Dart and Flutter projects. It helps maintain code quality and consistency across applications by defining shared static analysis options.
use_when: You want to enforce coding standards inspired by Theodo Apps across your Flutter codebase
You are looking to incorporate DCM rules into your static analysis setup
avoid_when: You prefer strict default official lints without custom team overrides
You do not use static analysis or DCM in your workflow
strengths: Pre-configured set of lint rules combining standard linter and DCM rules
Easy to integrate into existing projects via analysis_options.yaml
weaknesses: DCM rules require an external API key/license to run properly
Limited to the specific rule preferences chosen by Theodo Apps
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dev dependency and include the rules in your analysis_options.yaml file.
